steps.name: 新协议、候选语法与分组/数据角色冻结
steps.acceptance_summary: Freeze data roles, candidate grammar, T/F/U semantics, split feasibility, finite learning/search and evaluation contracts before model selection.

steps.name: 状态感知关系矩阵与泄漏隔离
steps.acceptance_summary: Account for all stages; cache only semantically unchanged label-independent predicates; separate values, availability and evaluation metadata.

steps.name: 选择器、合理基线和合成验证
steps.acceptance_summary: Implement and synthetically validate fold-local rule-set selection, baselines, tri-valued prediction and metrics; no real outer-fold fitting.

steps.name: 训练/评价作业与运行资源冻结
steps.acceptance_summary: Bind algorithms, fit/prediction units, folds, search budgets and complete runtime resources; isolated synthetic full-pipeline smoke only.

steps.name: 折内选择、折外评价与旧策略比较
steps.acceptance_summary: Refit every learned transform/selector inside each train fold; freeze model before outer predictions; retain every failure and all denominators.

steps.name: 同流程重训练的来源贡献
steps.acceptance_summary: Refit under each source pool with common folds/budgets; distinguish from post-fit deletion; keep mixed provenance and common semantic gates explicit.

steps.name: 跨层价值、状态/门控及冗余实验
steps.acceptance_summary: Fair single-layer refit versus cross-layer learning; separate frozen-model masking and semantic diagnostics without fabricated observability.

steps.name: 机制/环境迁移与可选前瞻确认

conditional_dependencies.prospective_confirmation: Independent material, final model freeze and separate user authorization; otherwise NOT_AVAILABLE, not a block on internal reporting.

steps.acceptance_summary: Preserve triad/repeated-group separation and report environment/mechanism confounding; never relabel an exposed split as prospective validation.

steps.name: 训练/推理成本与解释忠实性
steps.acceptance_summary: Record training/solver and inference costs separately; explanations reference actual model clauses and observed fields, not attack intent.

steps.name: 图表、论文主张、参考文献和复现包
steps.acceptance_summary: Each claim/figure binds saved results and its actual evidence scope; incomplete branches stay explicit; P6 is saved-output reuse only.

next_step_scope: Protocol, candidate grammar and grouped evaluation feasibility only. No real model fitting, new predictions or legacy S07 execution.

history.scope: Current dispatch migrated to R01-R10; all prior history remains in the exact archived blob and original frozen artifacts.
